description: This PHP source file defines the class `Crypt_Blowfish_DefaultKey`, which encapsulates a default key used in the Blowfish encryption algorithm. It initializes the P-array and S-boxes with specific predefined constants in the constructor, serving as part of a cryptographic implementation that allows encryption and decryption without relying on external PHP extensions.

classes.name: Crypt_Blowfish_DefaultKey
classes.description: A class containing the default cryptographic key components (P-array and S-boxes) for implementing the Blowfish encryption algorithm.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the P and S arrays with predefined Blowfish constants when an instance of the class is created.
